method: Whole JSON formatter source read and Git blob verified.
findings: Header records checksum algorithm/optional seed; replay loader previously reviewed ignores header and assumes first/last array elements metadata. no_header/no_footer outputs therefore need explicit compatibility handling not present in replay.

Unique records may contain unfinished digest when write_unfinished enabled; record includes checksum but no local hashed-byte count or digest-complete boolean. Replay trusts checksum strings, so partial-digest cache semantics require end-to-end control.
Output path sent directly to JsonObject string setter; explicit raw filename-byte encoding or invalidUTF8 recovery absent in formatter. JSON-GLib behavior not executed.
JSON stream open/separator/close writes ignore returned status. Generator failure logged without propagating result and allocated GError not freed in failure branch.

Generated32-bit IDs retry collision up to8192 then accept value without failure; generating hardlink_of calls ID generator again rather than retrieving prior assigned ID. Referential consistency needs focused runtime control.
JSON element callback mutates file is_original for unique records, so handler order can affect subsequent handlers receiving same model. Reachable mixed-output impact untested.
Footer progress always100 even when aborted boolean true; progress field alone is not completeness proof.
limits: No formatter runtime or replay roundtrip tests performed.
No rrrah edits/tests; native pHash deferred; global count150/500.
